title: Deny by Default
summary: A hardened Safe with no rules refuses every transaction, even when the owners sign.
lesson: Once the Policy Guard is installed, a transaction runs only if a rule covers it. Owner signatures are still needed, but they are no longer enough.

steps.label: Send 1 ETH to Dave
steps.note: Two of three owners signed, which satisfies the Safe. The guard still stops it: no rule covers sending ETH to Dave.

steps.label: Add the Recovery Module
steps.note: Changing the Safe itself is a transaction too. After hardening, adding a module needs a rule like anything else.

steps.label: Ask for a new rule
steps.note: One kind of call needs no rule: asking the Policy Guard for a rule change. Without that, a Safe with no rules could never get any.
